articles.summary: DUBLIN and SHANGHAI, May 20, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- PDD Holdings Inc. (“PDD Holdings” or the “Company”) (NASDAQ: PDD) today announced that it will report its unaudited financial results for the first quarter ended March 31, 2025, before U.S. markets open on Tuesday, May 27, 2025.
